title: Publication Gate Decision
description: Schema for recording a publication gate decision for a specific material. Fail-closed: the recorded decision is derived from the canonical source-rights registry by source_category; the submission must supply a verified provenance reference (source_rights_entry_id + content_digest_sha256), a free-text reason, a rule_ref, and a schema_version, and the tool finalizes rights_status + timestamps + provenance_verified. additionalProperties:false rejects any unknown field. Provenance is a verified reference to the registry entry — never a free-text self-assertion.

material_id.description: Unique identifier for the material being evaluated

rights_status.description: Rights status assessment, derived by the gate from source_category (not self-reported)

access_method.description: How the material was accessed (public URL, paywall, private account, etc.)

classification_level.description: Material classification level L0-L6 (derived from source_category, cross-checked against submission)

source_rights_entry_id.description: Registry category key this material's rights derive from. Must equal source_category and exist in source-rights-registry. This is the verified provenance reference (fail-closed: a registry pointer, never a free-text claim).

content_digest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the actual material/source text. Must match the registry entry's pinned content_digest_sha256 when the source is VERIFIED (tamper / consistency check).

provenance_record_id.description: Optional external provenance record id (e.g., an External Input Non-Republication Principle record) tying this decision to a broader provenance trail.

provenance_verified.description: Set by the gate (not the caller): true only when the submitted content_digest_sha256 matched a VERIFIED registry entry's pinned digest. A caller cannot self-assert verified provenance.

permission_obtained.description: Whether explicit permission was obtained (for BLOCK decisions that were later resolved)

counsel_review_completed.description: Whether legal counsel review was completed

quotation_limit.description: Maximum allowed quotation length if CONDITIONAL_PASS (e.g., 'up_to_500_words', 'excerpt_only')

reason.description: Human-readable rationale for the gate decision (required for auditability)

rule_ref.description: Reference to the governing rule/registry entry that justifies the decision (required)

schema_version.description: Version of the gate/registry contract this decision was recorded under (required)

reviewer.description: Who made the gate decision (agent name, human reviewer, etc.)
